{
  "name": "timeline",
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "description": "A pane with one card per turn of the session: what you asked, what Claude did, what it touched. Click a card to jump to that turn.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Yunjia Zheng",
    "url": "https://github.com/yunjiaz7"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/yunjiaz7/claude-timeline-mod",
  "repository": "https://github.com/yunjiaz7/claude-timeline-mod",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "timeline",
    "navigation",
    "summary",
    "pane",
    "mod"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "language": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Language the summaries are written in",
      "options": [
        "English",
        "Chinese",
        "Japanese",
        "Spanish",
        "French",
        "German"
      ],
      "default": "English",
      "title": "Summary language"
    },
    "replySummaries": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Summarise replies",
      "description": "Write what each turn did. Off: only your ask is summarised, and no call is made for the reply.",
      "default": true
    }
  }
}
